_doc: #1786 /v1/rates/sovereign-curves: the government yield curves FinTerm's CB/Home reads for the economies the yield store does not already serve as a full daily curve (GB spot, JP, CN). API-owned declaration, embedded by finterm/sovereign.rs: no provider address is typed in Rust. Per country the sources are tried in order (the first is the primary, the rest the fallbacks); a tenor a source does not publish is left out, never interpolated or made up. US: /v1/curves/ust_par (US Treasury daily par curve, treasury_xml). Euro area: /v1/curves/EA (ECB AAA spot curve, ecb_yc_aaa, yield store).

elsewhere.US: served by /v1/curves/ust_par (US Treasury daily par yield curve)
elsewhere.EA: served by /v1/curves/EA (ECB euro area AAA government spot curve)
